scope: Complete feasible targeted revision contrasts; no claim of independent confirmation; preserve E0-E16 and S0-S3
cohort: Same final-delivered valid-time Olist; same fit IDs and approval/feedback boundaries as S1
primary_backbone: Exact frozen S1 LR predictions and models; no refit of main LR
pools: Out-of-training a>=fit; a,r,e<daily midnight. e=max(r,promise_end). New PoolRate/Platt/BrierOpt use identical Expanding pool. Frozen fits once at evaluation start.
guard: N>=1000, positives>=50, negatives>=50; fails => Raw; no last-good carry-forward. Solver failure => same-day LL intercept and explicit flag; never silent.
PoolRate: Constant historical pool positive fraction, same guard
Platt: minimize mean logloss sigma(alpha+beta*logit(p)); alpha in [-30,30], beta in [0,10]; no penalty; L-BFGS-B analytic gradient; explicit boundary and convergence diagnostics
BrierOpt: 1D bounded [-30,30] Brier intercept; 241-point derivative grid, Brent every sign crossing, bounded refinement at local grid minima; compare all candidates/endpoints and LL solution; record gradient/boundary; no tuning to evaluation
periodic_backbone: S1 LR refit at eval start and +30days using all orders approved AND label-known before fit; train-only preprocessing; score next30days; raw probabilities only; no calibration on in-training scores
strong_backbone: CatBoost GPU0 fixed depth4 iterations300 learning_rate.05 l2_leaf_reg3 Bernoulli subsample1; no search/early stopping; S1 inputs; train-only numeric median for CatBoost missing values; raw/Frozen/Expanding/Rolling60/Approval60

restricted_features.reason: Drop static product/location attributes without version histories AND cohort-selected outcome histories; retain order/service/calendar and prior-approval counts. Combined stress test, not causal attribution.

calibration_diagnostics: Evaluation-only logistic alpha/slope of Raw and Expanding; 7day block bootstrap (2000), unconstrained two-parameter logistic with analytic Hessian; failed fits reported. Fixed explicit bins with block intervals and support. No diagnostic fitted values used to predict.
unknown_outcomes: Four S1 windows, expanded approval-time eligible noncanceled cohort. Original history only; frozen Raw plus exact daily Expanding offsets. Binary-label sharp Brier difference bounds; cancellation hypothetical extension separate. Snapshot horizon proxy, min followup0/30/60/90.
decision: Daily floor(5%*N) by p*order_value_proxy, compare Raw/Expanding/ValueOnly; ID stable ties; coverage and list changes; block paired coverage intervals
unavailable: No unexposed same-target new data or actual label-ingestion/field-version logs; not fabricated. No new dataset download or claim of prospective validation.

resources.GPU_nondeterminism: Fixed seed does not guarantee GPU bitwise refits; saved scores authoritative

public_copy_note: Original local paths replaced with basenames; original protocol remains in user archive.
